title.narrative: Poverty reduction in the Buffer Zone of the Gorongosa National Park - Bridging Period

description.narrative: Improve well being and resilience of communities in the Gorongosa National Park buffer zones, trough strengthened human development and poverty alleviation anchored in restored biodiversity and ecological processes., trough: (a) Improved education outcomes among girls and vulnerable learners, (2) Increased adoption of sustainable agriculture and agricforestry, and (3) Enhanced access to conservation-related livelihoods for local communities
